quote.text: The money is in the follow-up. Same leads, same offer — the only variable left is how fast and how many times you reach out.
quote.author: Alex Hormozi

schedule: No calls on the books. Check GHL/Calendly for overnight bookings, then get the HighLevel onboarding call booked before noon.
focus: Chase just posted a notice that a credit card payment was returned and they're retrying the charge — a step worse than Tuesday's statement alert. Confirm whether that card funds your $35/day FB Ads and clear it today, because a declined card pauses Meta delivery and kills your only live lead channel.

Still 0 closed from 27+ leads at a ~$17 CPL — roughly $460+ spent on people who never booked, and zero prospect replies in the last 48 hours. Run a personal text-and-call blitz through every unbooked GHL lead today with a direct booking link. The traffic is fine; speed and volume of follow-up is the only lever left.

Verify today's FB ad is delivering and the 9 AM auto-post hit all 16 groups. At $35/day with no closes you can't afford a silent delivery failure burning budget, and the group posts are your only free top-of-funnel.
gmail_summary: No prospect replies or warm conversations in the last 48 hours. The one item that matters: Chase posted a notice that a credit card payment was returned and they're retrying it — flag this against the card funding FB Ads before delivery is affected. Everything else is routine: a vague '14-day trial extension granted' from acct-mgmt.com, a Hulu new-device sign-in (iPhone, Springfield MA), a Shopify order link, Capital One payment-received confirmations, plus DraftKings, Ignition, Michaels and Bank of America promos. Nothing needs a reply.
gmail_items: 🔴 Chase — Credit card payment returned, Chase retrying the charge
